reproduce.expected_result: Editor and overlay have a deliberate consistent corner policy while snapping, hit testing and accessible contrast remain unchanged.
steps: Compare the same layout in editor and Shift-drag overlay.
Exercise highlighted/nonhighlighted and multi-zone selection at mixed DPI.
Check high contrast, Windows10/11 and tiny-zone corner clamping.
Confirm a visual-only change leaves snapped rectangles and selection targets unchanged.
reproduce.version_requirement: Current stable and current development build
prerequisites: Use a disposable layout with large, tiny and overlapping zones; preserve existing layouts.

actions.label: Compare editor and activation overlay corners

judgment.recommended_action: Scope a normal-overlay rendering-only change with editor parity and accessibility controls.
judgment.rationale: The mismatch is understandable and has a narrow renderer owner. Treat it as visual-consistency work, preserve snap/hit-test behavior and decide the radius/accessibility policy before implementation.
evidence: Read the complete0.64.0 report, empty comments and timeline; inspected both supplied screenshots.
The editor view shows rounded zone outlines while the Shift-drag activation overlay has square corners; the request is about rendering, not failure to snap.
Current native ZonesOverlay zone drawing uses FillRectangle/DrawRectangle for zone fills and outlines; separate rounded ghost animation rendering is not the normal zone draw path.
A focused open-issue search returned no additional owner, which is not proof no related work exists; no current installed overlay was exercised.

proposed_fixes.title: Align normal zone-overlay corners with editor visuals
plan: Agree on editor/native radius policy and small-zone/DPI clamping.
Apply rounded drawing to normal highlighted and inactive zone fill/outline paths, not only animation ghosts.
Keep layout rectangles, hit testing and snapping coordinates unchanged.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Current normal zone fills/outlines are rectangular; use a deliberate visual corner policy rather than changing snap geometry.

confidence.rationale: The screenshot difference and current drawing boundary are clear; runtime visuals and policy approval remain outstanding.

verification: Compare editor/overlay at mixed DPI and high contrast.
Retain tiny/overlapping/multizone snap and selection tests.
